Find the opening hours of the National Museum in Delhi and the ticket price
7:34 AM

The National Museum in New Delhi (Janpath, New Delhi - 110011) is open today, Wed 28 Oct, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM, according to its official site.

Opening hours

Tue to Fri: 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM
Sat and Sun: 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM
Closed on Mondays and national holidays

Entry fee

Adults: ₹20
Foreign nationals: ₹500
Students up to class 12: free, with an I-card

The site lists online booking at zoonga.com/national-museum. I have not booked anything. The page may not be up to date, so check the holiday calendar on the site before you go.
